sources.quote: Two exoplanets orbit it, designated as TOI-5788 b and TOI-5788 c, where the former is classified as a rocky planet and the latter is a mini-Neptune.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5788. Its orbit and size follow Lakeland et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
